audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] told the user to 'Windwall his Riftwalk', and nothing said which of Kassadin's spells Wind Wall actually stops.
audit.why: Riftwalk is a self-targeted teleport (kit flag: dash) with no projectile — Wind Wall cannot touch it. Only Null Sphere (Q) carries the projectile flag. Force Pulse (E) is a cone in front of him and passes straight through the wall, and Nether Blade (W) is an empowered auto. The mirror audit on Kassadin's page states the same.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall eats Null Sphere (Q) only. Force Pulse (E) is a cone that goes through it, Riftwalk is a blink, Nether Blade is an auto.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page was built around 'track Riftwalk', and packet.defects flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2 seconds — it is never 'down' in any useful sense, so tracking it is not actionable. Force Pulse at 21/20/19/18/17s is the punishable cooldown, and Null Sphere is 9s down to 7s. Last Breath is 70s at rank 1 and can only blink to an airborne target.
audit.corrected: Refocused the cooldown lines on Force Pulse (21s at rank 1) and Null Sphere, and stated Riftwalk's true 5s rank-1 cadence in the level-6 prose.

audit.why: Chart gives Yasuo every row but level 6 (Skill), which matches a melee dive lane against a pre-6 Kassadin with no waveclear. The mirror recorded no chart changes, so I left the rows untouched rather than introduce a disagreement — but see notes on row 7.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of Kassadin's auto-attack reset tell.
audit.why: Nether Blade (W) carries the autoReset flag — his damage spike is an auto wind-up, so the visual cue to disengage is the attack animation, not a spell cast.
audit.corrected: Added the Nether Blade wind-up tell to spikes[0].
